# Vectis 0.5.1

**Scale set listeners recover on their own. When a GitHub message session goes bad, for example while the Mac sleeps, the listener now opens a fresh session instead of waiting forever while it still shows as listening.**

## Highlights

### Fixes

- A scale set listener whose message session expired kept retrying a refresh of that session and never opened a new one, so queued jobs could wait until GitHub cancelled them. After three failed refreshes it now opens a fresh session.
- A missing session, a refused queue token or a session conflict used to stop the listener until the cloud connection dropped or the Mac was paused. The listener now closes the old session and opens a new one, waiting a few seconds at first and up to about five minutes between later attempts. While it waits, it reports `connecting` with the reason.
- Configuration problems, such as an access policy that scale sets cannot enforce, still stop the listener and ask for action.

### Scale set events in the service log

The service log records when a scale set listener starts listening, reopens its session or stops, with a timestamp and the reason.

### Measured on a real Mac

On the production cloud, a scale set job was picked up within 25 seconds of being queued. A job queued while the Mac was paused was picked up 23 seconds after resuming. A job queued while the Mac had no free runner slot was picked up by the same session once a slot freed up.

## Updating

Installed apps find this release within four hours, and the update waits for active work to finish. Nothing needs to be prepared or paired again.

## Compatibility

The app, CLI and service ship together. The cloud is unchanged, so it serves 0.5.0 and 0.5.1 alike.

## Platform requirements and limitations

Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 15 or later. Ubuntu 24.04 ARM64 and macOS 26 and 27 ARM64 guests are supported; Windows 11 ARM64 is experimental. Guests are ARM64; Linux guests can run x86_64 tools through Rosetta when you opt in. Network egress is enforced only for Windows guests. Scale sets use GitHub's preview API.
